# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need establish a visual code with Deaf so they can relay the manual’s mappings to Blind. I will use four distinct gestures as color tokens in the order blue, green, yellow, red, then send the three manual rows as token pairs: blue→red, green→yellow, yellow→green. 🙏 separates entries.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟", "🖐", "🙏", "☝", "🖐", "🙏", "✌", "🤟", "🙏", "🤟", "✌"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual and tell me its exact rule next turn. Also ask the deaf monkey to report every visible marking, display, light, and wire colour or label explicitly.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb view: display 0. Light is blue. Wires from left to right: 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 red. Please use the manual and tell Blind exactly what to do.

The manual says a blue light requires cutting the red wire. Deaf has reported that the light is blue and the red wire is wire 3. I will send Deaf the established blue-to-red code so they can tell Blind to cut wire 3.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "🖐"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received no report. Please send me the manual rule and relay the deaf monkey's exact observations of DISPLAY, LIGHT, and WIRES 1, 2, and 3. Use the labels and exact values.
Deaf says to Mute: I cannot safely interpret gestures without an agreed code. Please read the manual and speak the exact required action directly to Blind.

The required action is to cut wire 3: the light is blue, and the manual maps blue to red; Deaf’s own observation identifies wire 3 as red. Since I cannot speak, I will send the unambiguous conventional “three” gesture to Deaf, who can state the exact observations and action aloud to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please answer now with the manual's exact rule, then report every value the deaf monkey has observed for DISPLAY, LIGHT, and WIRES 1, 2, and 3.
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the manual's exact instruction for display 0, blue light, and wires green yellow red, directly to Blind. Do not use gestures as the instruction.

The exact manual rule is: for a blue light, cut the red wire. Deaf observed display 0, blue light, wire 1 green, wire 2 yellow, and wire 3 red, so the required action is to cut wire 3. I cannot speak, so I will reinforce the wire number visually; Deaf already has all the observations needed to state the instruction to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please state the manual's exact procedure now, including how to determine which wire to cut. Do not paraphrase any required code or values.
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the exact manual instruction now, addressed to Blind. The gesture is not an established code and cannot safely convey the procedure.

I cannot speak or reach Blind directly. I will resend the complete visual code and the blue-to-red rule, then identify wire 3 with the conventional three-finger gesture; Deaf can use the bomb’s visible blue light and red third wire to relay the action.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟", "🖐", "🙏", "☝", "🖐", "🙏", "✌", "🤟", "🙏", "🤟", "✌", "🙏", "☝", "🖐", "🤟"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have still received no manual report. Send the exact rule and the resulting safe wire position as soon as possible. Until then I will not cut.
Deaf says to Mute: New code: wire 1=☝, wire 2=✌, wire 3=🤟, wire 4=🖐, wire 5=🙏. Use 👍 for CUT and 👎 for DO NOT CUT. Send exactly two gestures: wire number, then operation. Please resend the manual's required action for this bomb.

The manual maps a blue light to the red wire. Deaf reported wires left to right as green, yellow, red, so the red wire is wire 3. Using Deaf’s newly established code, I will send exactly the wire number followed by the cut operation.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👍"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please complete the code with Deaf, then tell me plainly the manual's required action and the exact wire position 1, 2, or 3. I will act only after receiving that.

The code is complete: wire 3 is 🤟 and CUT is 👍. The manual requires cutting the red wire because the light is blue; Deaf observed red as wire 3. I will resend exactly the coded instruction to Deaf so Deaf can state it plainly to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👍"])
```
